### God Restores What Is Running Low - Your Nightly Prayer - July 9th
Author: Rachel Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/god-restores-what-is-running-low.html
Passage: Psalm 23:3
Points:
- Daily life and heavy responsibilities often leave believers depleted and weary.
- Striving for self-reliance makes resting in the Shepherd difficult to practice.
- God promises to replenish our strength and restore equilibrium to our souls.
- The Lord guides us faithfully along right paths for His own name's sake.
- Entrusting tomorrow to the Good Shepherd brings restful peace tonight.

### Shepherded by Jesus – Praying through Psalm 23 – Pt. 1
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/shepherded-by-jesus-praying-through-psalm-23-pt-1/
Passage: Psalm 23:1-3
Points:
- Knowing Jesus as our Good Shepherd assures us of His constant care and complete provision.
- When human busyness becomes relentless, God lovingly makes us pause and rest.
- Christ provides spiritual quietness that calms noisy, cluttered hearts.
- Earthly wealth, success, and relationships cannot bring true soul restoration.
- Following the Shepherd along grace-filled paths brings honor to His name.
